notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.14] Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content: [p]Hello Players, [/p][p]In this letter, we would like to inform you of our development progress and our upcoming event participation.  [/p][p]While it can be difficult to visually convey development progress, and some information cannot yet be disclosed, development is proceeding on a daily basis! [/p][p][/p][h3]- Persistent display of card effect targets during battle[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/0b0cdf7065c567233992f3522761b2429789aa32.gif"][/img][/p][p]To address the issue that "it is difficult to tell what a card is targeting," we have made the target indicators persistently visible. [/p][p]When retargeting manually, non-selectable targets are dimmed to improve clarity.  [/p][p][/p][h3]- Event participation announcement [/h3][p]We will be participating in the indie game web-only event "EARLY TAKES" on October 4. [url="https://event.toranoana.jp/web-only/312253/"]https://event.toranoana.jp/web-only/312253/[/url][/p][p]We are preparing to make the exhibition demo playable online as well. Participation is free, so please feel free to drop by!   [/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to it.   [/p][p]We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.13]　Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content: [p]Hello Players,[/p][p]Today we participated in the indie game exhibition "Game Pavilion JP" held in Osaka, and visitors played the demo at our booth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f46796a7265abeef6be4b0fabe7ccff6946f2fb0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who stopped by despite the rain and for your valuable feedback. [/p][p]We will use the feedback we received to further refine the game. We will continue to improve, and we would be grateful for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also sharing a preview of some screens currently under development:[/p][p][/p][p]- Begun English localization[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f854ea22605a6c7abe57d8836bb1c984d148e8eb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f5787e625e39ce1e5400c7149289147147befb6d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/df652b768394b5061845be894789a667526a8222.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/3f5c9fa834f7a8cfc9c97ecaa3e73115fb12848a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]- Implemented a command to change characters' expressions during dialogue[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/7fbe45b455ff951cb4afa3c45bf05652c00e430b.gif"][/img][/p][p]- Battle finish cinematics[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/feeb192a5aa8bf0052afd89b99576033c3c0e4e0.png"][/img][/p][p]- Card pack opening animation[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/ffce97176789f0ef9a41e6bf3fdb0a9dffb2c8e6.png"][/img][/p][p]Our next exhibition appearance is scheduled for this autumn. [/p][p]By then, we plan to deliver a version that is easier to play and features more polished presentation. [/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to it. [/p][p]We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us![/p]

notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.11] Chara Intro.11&12：Honjo Haruka & Kuruma Shuichi
notes.content:
[p]Hello to all players.[/p][p]From this issue, we will introduce the adults surrounding the student characters introduced in the previous issues.[/p][p][/p][h1]Character Introduction[/h1][p][/p][p] Name: Honjo Haruka[/p][p]"I see. So you'd like to ask this super genius for a favor. Do you have anything for me?"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/bbf40e08b4ecfc70feb3b7559fe89163d7022eac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]She is a clinical researcher and was the doctor in charge of Uzura when she was hospitalized.[/p][p]She calls herself a super genius.[/p][p][/p][p]A word of character note: “Droopy eyes, Sanpaku, and long lower eyelash.”[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Name: Kuruma Shuichi[/p][p]"Let me tell you, I don't run a toy store."[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f1ec553b61467870c889d204ec70c2e1e8b64d11.png"][/img][/p][p]Owner of the antique store “Emerald Green”. Cards for Erase are available at this store.[/p][p]Polite but sometimes insidious.[/p][p][/p][p]A word of character note: “The braided part is held in place with a barrette in the back.”
[/p][hr][/hr][p]We are looking forward to seeing how their story will unfold in the main game![/p][p]This is the last character we can introduce before the game is released to the public. Other characters will of course appear.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/67509cdcf1568ab9274ed326642a454ff57903e6.png"][/img][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you again in the next issue.  [/p][p]We are still working hard on it, so please support “Erase” by adding it to your wish list if you haven't done so already!  [/p]

notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.2] Chara Intro.1：Natsuyagi Uzura
notes.content: [p]Hello to all players. [/p][p]It has been a week since we opened our Steam Store, and we are very happy to receive your warm support for “Erase”. Thank you very much! [/p][p]In this newsletter, we would like to introduce the main character of the game, Uzura Natsuyagi. Character introductions have been done on [url="https://ci-en.net/creator/26277"]ci-en[/url] and the [url="https://brainmixer.net/Erase/index.html"]official website[/url], but I would like to talk briefly about the characters in terms of character design.  [/p][p][/p][h1]Character Introduction[/h1][p]Name: Natsuyagi Uzura [/p][p]"I wouldn't mind. My wishes have all been granted."[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/1e559733cf45fdad0c80389acf69daf903b10700.png"][/img][/p][p]The protagonist of this story. She is a second-year junior high school student living in Kyoto who has been hospitalized for a long time.[/p][p]The story begins on the first day of school after she is discharged from the hospital. She is cheerful and energetic at heart, but she is not used to socializing with people her own age. She loves to read.[/p][p][/p][p]Uzura's character design is based on the “little bird” motif. In particular, her hair habit is based on the feathers of a bird.[/p][p]As is generally the case with characters in Erase, I start with the name, personality, and settings, and then flesh out the appearance.[/p][p]In the case of Uzura, her name is straight out of a bird, and her “curious but sensitive” personality is also parrot-like.[/p][p]By the way, I wonder what Uzura herself thinks of the eggs and the bird “quail” ......?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/c0ab00ae8a3db7f40eb7afb192dc367abcf9481e.png"][/img][/p][p]The first character sketches I found when I dug through my files.[/p][p][/p][p]See you next time.[/p][p]Please support “Erase” by adding it to your wish list if you haven't already![/p]

notes.title: 【Erase Letter vol.1】Steam Store opening and MY GAME FES Exhibition
notes.content: [p]Hello to all players.[/p][p]I am 糸冬ぼたん, the graphic designer of Erase.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Boys and girls who are approaching the abyss of the Cthulhu Mythos[/i][/p][p][i]"Erase -missing link-", a TRPG-style card game adventure of repeated exploration and growth[/i][/p][p]Steam store is open to the public today![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/7e33e508fc9235e7c3f90d84099e2343273339d7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In this erase news letter, we will regularly send out information on development and other topics through letters.[/p][p]Mr. #6, who is in charge of programming (& planning/scenario) for this game, is also publishing development articles on ci-en, but we are sharing the tasks and the articles on Steam are mainly updated by our graphical artists.[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to release the game in the winter of 2025, and in the meantime, we are planning to attend more and more indie game exhibitions.[/p][p]First of all, we have applied to exhibit at the PICREA event \[INDIE GAME WEB EVENT “MY GAME FES” Vol. 3]![/p][p]This is a web-based indie game exhibition event that is free of charge for the general public (*membership registration to PICREA is required).[/p][p]Even if it is difficult to attend a local event due to distance or time, you can visit the space 24 hours a day, as long as you can use the Internet. Please feel free to drop by.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, I hope to talk more about the contents of the game in the next issue![/p][p]What kind of characters are there?　What is it like to play a “card game x object puzzle”?　And so on...[/p][p]We will try to post more frequently, once a week if possible, so please follow us and stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]We would also appreciate it if you could add us to your wish list![/p][p]Thank you very much for your support![/p]
